Fill your freezer with locally raised pork from Roswell Family Farm!

🐖 Live Hogs: $2.50/lb (live weight)
🥩 Whole Hog: $3.50/lb (hanging weight) + butcher processing fees
🥩 Half Hog: $4.00/lb (hanging weight) + butcher processing fees

💰 Deposits Required
• Whole Hog: $150
• Half Hog: $100

🚨 IMPORTANT – CUSTOMER PROCESSING DEADLINE 🚨

If you want customer processing pricing, we must receive your deposit by Tuesday morning so we can reserve your spot with the processor.

After Tuesday morning, customer processing will be unavailable until December. Hogs can still be processed under USDA processing, but pricing for processing is different.

✅ Whether you choose customer processing or USDA processing, your pork will still be cut, wrapped, and packaged by the processor, and processing fees are paid directly to the butcher when you pick up your finished order.

📩 Message Roswell Family Farm today to reserve your whole or half hog before Tuesday morning!

👽 FRIDAY FARM REPORT FROM ROSWELL FAMILY FARM

While the weekend is just getting started for most people, ours is already in full swing.

This week we’ve been feeding animals, checking fences, moving pasture, and getting ready for another busy week ahead.

Every sunrise on the farm is another chance to raise healthy animals and produce food we’re proud to put on our neighbors’ tables.

We wouldn’t be here without your support, and we appreciate every share, every comment, and every order.

Now we want to know…

What are your plans this weekend? 🌞 #weekendvibes #fyp #farmtotable
